what: The plan-against-itself gate: reads charters' filed_edges and finds work the component admits is unbuilt. Complements the build_inspector (code against code) — this one reads the PLAN's own admissions and surfaces them before a planning surface can read a component as done while it says otherwise. Two sieves: open_filed_edges (any open filed edge — the component's own record of what it does not yet do) and charter_asserts_unbuilt (edges that explicitly name unbuilt work — 'not yet wired', 'deferred', 'waits on'). CLI: `python3 -m cairn.machines.plan_inspector.inspector [component]`. Exit 0 = clean, 1 = findings. Inference-free by construction.
why: Provenance: 2026-07-26 — Akien asked for a step-back sanity check and CC found three components (inferenceproxy, db_domain, web_server) reading as done on the build order while their own filed_edges said otherwise. The hand-run became the instrument (Law 1). The deeper why: a filed_edge is the component's own honest record of what it does not yet do — a planning surface that cannot read these is planning against claims the components themselves deny.
invoke: CLI: `python3 -m cairn.machines.plan_inspector.inspector` (whole repo) or `python3 -m cairn.machines.plan_inspector.inspector <component>`. Import: `from cairn.machines.plan_inspector.inspector import inspect`. Prove: `python3 -m cairn.machines.plan_inspector.proofs.test_inspector`.
how_it_learns: Same pattern as build_inspector: a new class of planning mismatch seeds a new sieve. The growth rule: a gap Akien catches that this inspector could have caught becomes a sieve (Law 1).
filed_edges: (a) the founding measurement surfaced inferenceproxy, db_domain, and web_server — the instrument is built and running; the three original components still RED on today's tree (falsifier verified 2026-08-20)

(b) CLOSED 2026-08-20 — letter-prefixed edges like '(b) CLOSED 2026-08-08...' were read as open because _is_closed checked the raw string starting with '(' not 'CLOSED'. Fixed by stripping letter prefixes before the check. Proven by test_letter_prefix_closed and test_letter_prefix_in_charter.

design_boundary.akien: A step-back sanity check that the plan agrees with itself (Akien 2026-07-26).
design_boundary.cc: The instrument and both of its sieves (open_filed_edges and its sibling); CC turned the hand-run into the machine.
design_boundary.settled_by: A red over CC's part is adjudicated by CC against that part's own why (17.11.6); Akien may be asked whether it could be better, with both whys laid out, and what CC cannot sort goes to him (17.11.6.1).
